text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCSDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedByProfessorD(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) ∧ FromCSDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) → WorksInLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university work in the library.
∀x (TakesDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCSDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedByProfessorD(x) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructedByProfessorD(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(James) ∧ WorksInLab(James) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬HasPartTimeJob(Jack) ∧ ¬WorksInLab(Jack) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬HasPartTimeJob(James) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
